scope: CPU-only preparation workflow for new train-log-only 0-6m shared-model inputs; no real sensor preparation or training was started on this Mac

data_contract.selection: GT-only deterministic six-cell, log/camera-fair selection, retaining scarce sub-2m/sub-1m views before fill
data_contract.near: Original-resolution sparse object-owned positive camera-Z points in (0,6], exact reviewed masks, no hole interpolation
data_contract.broad: Separate conservative 2-80m sparse protection references from the same source scans
data_contract.readiness: At least two unique instance tracks and two recording logs in each selected near cell; minimal diversity only, not accuracy or qualification
data_contract.camera_gaps: All six camera channels reported; missing cells flagged rather than treated as zero error

io_and_resume.coverage_snapshot: One reusable source_state.zip binds the reviewed 537 coverage chunks and download manifest
io_and_resume.default: Use a Drive website coverage-folder ZIP upload; initial small mounted-Drive chunk reads require explicit opt-in
io_and_resume.source_archives: Sequential verified copy of at most one sensor part at a time; about 45 GB may be read once for all ten source parts
io_and_resume.durable_training_outputs: One ZIP per completed source part, containing bounded RGB/near-GT/broad-GT shards
io_and_resume.same_vm: Reuse verified local source state, selected plan, completed shards and publication acknowledgements
io_and_resume.new_vm: Restore completed source/selection/part archives; one read of each restored archive and no immediate duplicate verification read from Drive
io_and_resume.interruption: Completed part archives survive on Drive; unfinished source transfers/shards resume on the same VM, but an unfinished part may rebuild after VM deletion
io_and_resume.quota: Errno 5 stops with no automatic retry or remount; quota or mount failure remains a possibility, not a confirmed diagnosis

verification.synthetic_end_to_end: Raw sensor archive -> selected original RGB + measured sub-2m GT + separate broad GT -> immutable part archive -> preparation report
verification.validation_limit: No 4096-view package, training-data readiness result or new model score is claimed before the user runs Colab.
